arguments.summary: An APT intrusion was detected originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to user CORP\jsmith in the Finance department. The initial access vector was a malicious PowerShell script launched from Outlook, leading to execution of a Cobalt Strike beacon via rundll32.exe from the Temp directory. The host exhibited C2 communication with external IP 198.51.100.23 and attempted lateral movement via SMB to file server 10.0.5.50. IOCs were confirmed through IDS alerts and EDR process tree analysis. The compromised host has been isolated via firewall block (inbound/outbound).

    CommandLine|contains: '-nop'
    CommandLine|contains: '-w hidden'

level: high
